Good day. My daughter marries in June and it falls to me to make the plan of the tables. Please make on the top one long table for the spouses and the parents.
Under her put please five round tables, all of one size.
Give them the numbers from 1 until 5.
The long one must have written Young Couple and Parents.
Table 3 is the family of the groom, these sit together. Make her green so that I remember.
And the number 2 is of my sister. Now I see that she stays very near of the long table and the sister of my husband not, it will be a scandal. Change between them the 2 and the 4.
Also the musicians need a place. On the right, near the wall.
Uncle Radu cannot stay near of the musicians because of the ear. In which table is he, it is the 5, is that not the closest?
Then the 5 goes to the left and you bring the 1 in her place.
A table for the children, more small, yellow, by the door.
There is no door in the drawing, I did not tell you. The door is at the bottom left. You make there one small brown rectangle with the word Door and the table of the children you put beside.
From where the guests enter until the long table they must see a free way, for the entrance of the bride. It seems to me that the tables close it.
How many round tables do we have now, with the one of the children?
Write under the title of the drawing the date, 14 June.
There is no title, you are right, excuse me. Make it: Maria and Andrei.
How much should we give per person to the restaurant, do you know, in June the prices are bigger?
Thank you very much, you have much patience. I show it to my daughter tonight.
